title: OfflineAttestationChallengeResponse
description: HTTP response body of the server's attestation-challenge endpoint (POST /api/v1/offline/attestation-challenges) per spec/profiles/offline/app-contract.md 3.6. The app puts the challenge into the platform's attestation of its device key, and the server accepts it once, from the user it issued it to, before expiresAt.

expiresAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp after which the server no longer accepts the challenge.
